Privacy policy

This privacy policy explains what information this website collects, why it collects it, and how long it is kept. It applies to the website only. The Tesselate command-line tool runs entirely on your own machine and sends nothing anywhere, and the browser inspector reads files locally without uploading them.

The website sets one first-party cookie, used to count unique visits per day. The cookie stores a random identifier that is not linked to a name, an email address or an account, because the site has no accounts. The identifier is rotated daily, so visits on different days are not connected to each other. If you decline the cookie in the banner, it is not set and the visit is not counted at all.

The web server records a standard access log containing the requested path, the HTTP status code, the response size, the referring page where the browser supplies one, and a truncated form of the network address with the final octet removed. These logs are kept for fourteen days and are used to diagnose errors and to size the server. They are not combined with the analytics counter and are not shared with anyone.

No third-party analytics, advertising, tag management or session-recording service is loaded on any page of this site. There are no social media embeds. Fonts and scripts are served from this domain rather than from a content delivery network, so loading a page does not disclose your visit to another company.

Because the site holds no account data and no contact records, there is normally nothing to export or delete on request. If you have written to the project by email, that message sits in an ordinary mailbox and you can ask for it to be deleted at any time. Requests are handled by the maintainers directly.

This policy is versioned in the same repository as the site itself, so its history is public. Material changes are noted in the repository changelog rather than being applied silently. The policy is reviewed whenever a dependency that could affect it changes.
